title: cdc-slot
blurb: A fast CDC consumer advances global retention past a slow slot, while acknowledgements can skip changes that were never delivered.
brief:
A simulated change log serves independent search and analytics consumers. When search catches up, compaction deletes changes analytics has not processed. A client can also acknowledge an arbitrary future sequence and make its own gap permanent.

Treat each slot's delivered and acknowledged positions as durable database state. Retention may remove a change only after every active slot acknowledges it.

**Your job:** fence acknowledgements to delivered ranges, keep progress monotonic, and compact at the slowest active slot without penalizing dropped consumers.
